Strategy: Reward post-placement residuals that fall in either of two windows: nearly exact, or just below one full item, so bins either close out or stay ready to pair with another same-size item. It may help by creating clean states, but may fail if residuals rarely land inside the narrow windows.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item <= 5 or (r - item >= item - 5 and r - item <= item) else 0) for r in bins]
```
